title.th: ข้อบังคับบริษัท (การโอนการจดทะเบียน) 2017

completenessNote: 全文，共 14 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。其中 1 条为官方正文中标注的已废止条文存根（照录）。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Companies (Transfer of Registration) Regulations 2017 and come into operation on 11 October 2017.

heading.en: Prescribed form under section 358(2)(a) of Act

text.en: 2. For the purposes of section 358(2)(a) of the Act, the prescribed form is the form set out on the Authority’s website at www.acra.gov.sg/redomiciliation_application_form.

heading.en: Certification of documents under section 358(2)(b)(i) of Act
Prescribed documents under section 358(2)(b)(iii) of Act

text.en: 5. For the purposes of section 359(3) of the Act, the form of the notice of transfer of registration to be issued by the Registrar upon registration of a foreign corporate entity is set out in the Schedule.

heading.en: Form of application under section 359(7) of Act

text.en: 6. For the purposes of section 359(7) of the Act, an application for an extension of the 60‑day period mentioned in section 359(6) of the Act must be in the form set out on the Authority’s website at www.acra.gov.sg/deregistration_EOT_application_form.

chapter.en: PART 5 APPLICATION OF ACT TO REGISTERED FOREIGN CORPORATE ENTITIES

heading.en: Modification and exclusion of provisions of section 22 of Act

text.en:
8. In the application of section 22 of the Act to a foreign corporate entity registered under Part 10A of the Act —
(a)subsections (1)(c), (d), (e), (f) and (g), (1AA), (1AB), (1A) and (2) of that section are excluded; and
(b)subsection (4) of that section is modified by disregarding the words “, duly signed by the subscribers and stating, if the company is to have a share capital, the number of shares that each subscriber has agreed to take,”.
[S 299/2025 wef 31/12/2021]

chapter.en: PART 5 APPLICATION OF ACT TO REGISTERED FOREIGN CORPORATE ENTITIES

text.en:
9. Section 144 of the Act does not apply to a foreign corporate entity registered under Part 10A of the Act for the first 3 months immediately after the date of registration of the foreign corporate entity.
[S 299/2025 wef 31/12/2021]

chapter.en: PART 5 APPLICATION OF ACT TO REGISTERED FOREIGN CORPORATE ENTITIES

text.en:
12. In the application of section 205 of the Act to a foreign corporate entity registered under Part 10A of the Act, subsection (1) of that section is modified by reading the reference to “3 months after incorporation of the company” as a reference to “3 months after the date of registration of the foreign corporate entity”.
[S 299/2025 wef 31/12/2021]
